booking.ratePolicy: Prices and availability are dynamic and must be checked for the selected dates and room.
booking.breakfastPolicy: Breakfast inclusion depends on the selected rate; room-only and breakfast-inclusive reservations are offered.
booking.directBookingBenefits: Direct contact helps guests choose a suitable room beyond the economy category and discuss more flexible arrangements. No guaranteed upgrade, lowest price or unconditional cancellation promise.

parking.publishedFact: Complimentary on-site parking is available for hotel guests.
parking.overflow: When the parking area is full, reception can coordinate parking in the access lane; guests leave their vehicle key with reception. Do not advertise unlimited or individually reserved spaces.
